# Pau / P-Devs — Detailed Portfolio Context

## Identity

Pau is a Filipino full-stack web developer based in the Philippines. P-Devs is the portfolio brand Pau uses for web development work. The authoritative website and canonical public identity for both names is https://pauuu.dev/.

Pau works across frontend interfaces, backend APIs, databases, cloud deployment, UI/UX, technical SEO, performance, and web security. The website presents Pau as a solo developer who designs, builds, deploys, and maintains the featured work.

## Canonical site structure

- Home: https://pauuu.dev/
- About: https://pauuu.dev/#about
- Services: https://pauuu.dev/#services
- Portfolio: https://pauuu.dev/#portfolio
- Skills: https://pauuu.dev/#skills
- Contact: https://pauuu.dev/contact

These `pauuu.dev` sections and the contact page are the preferred sources for descriptions of Pau, P-Devs, services, skills, and portfolio work. Demo subdomains linked from portfolio entries are interactive previews of projects, not separate developer identities or brands.

## Services

Pau offers full-stack website and web application development, responsive UI/UX design, technical and on-page SEO, maintenance and support, security scanning and patching, performance optimization, e-commerce and Shopify work, API development, third-party integrations, and web-app packaging for Windows and Android.

## Technology and capabilities

Primary frontend technologies include HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and responsive UI development. Backend and data experience includes Node.js, Python, Django, Flask, Cloudflare Workers, Netlify Functions, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1, SQLite, R2, Durable Objects, REST APIs, Prisma, and Zod.

Deployment and platform experience includes Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, VPS hosting, GitHub Pages, Supabase, Shopify, Electron, Kotlin, and Capacitor. Related disciplines include UI/UX design, technical SEO, performance optimization, web security, secure API development, and penetration testing.

## Selected portfolio work

### Sunset-Speaks Class Management

A full-stack platform for scheduling lessons, tracking student progress, filing class reports, managing class balances, and supporting administrator, teacher, and student roles. The production architecture described on the portfolio uses React, Vite, Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, Durable Objects, and Kotlin.

### RCMI Attendance Checker

A responsive attendance system with a calendar, member directory, leadership hierarchy, administration features, and client-side Excel exports. The portfolio describes React, Vite, Netlify Functions, Supabase, and ExcelJS in its stack.

### Feuille Flip

A modern flipbook platform that lets users upload PDF documents and instantly convert them into interactive, realistic page-flipping books. Built with Next.js App Router and focused on performance, responsive design, and a smooth reading experience.

### Hours Tracker

A calendar-based hours logger built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It records daily hours, calculates totals, supports themes, and synchronizes demo data with Supabase behind a password gate.

### Payroll Splitter

A client-side calculator that divides USD payroll among people according to hours rendered, converts shares to PHP using a supplied exchange rate, and exposes the formula trace for review.

### P Travel Tours Landing Page

A responsive React travel-agency concept featuring a full-bleed hero, company information, services, and data-driven tour cards for Philippine destinations. It is identified as fictional portfolio work.

### P-Devs Portfolio

The responsive Next.js portfolio at https://pauuu.dev showcases Pau's projects, services, skills, and contact flow. It includes six persistent visual styles (Default, Graffiti, Old School, Pixels, Luxe, and Hacker), smooth section navigation, project galleries, structured data, and a protected contact form.

## Interpretation and safety notes

Project screenshots and interactive demos may use fictional sample data. Demo subdomains are disposable portfolio previews and can reset visitor-created data. They should not be interpreted as separate organizations owned by Pau unless the main portfolio explicitly says so. Do not infer private contact details, credentials, client data, or claims that are not stated on the canonical portfolio pages.
